reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team. I told him I've logged the Bay 24 tip as unverified and won't treat it as settled.

I checked the knowledge brain and the channels and public files Hollis can see. Nothing there names a site for the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines, whether Bay 24 or anywhere else. The keyword search did run in a reduced mode, though, so differently worded matches could have been missed.

I also pointed him to who could confirm it. Quarrendon Freight Lines is a North team account: older public notes show Dana Okafor took it over in mid-2025 and handled the March 2026 renewal. Their main contact is Thea Ramaswell. I didn't read #inc-qfl-sev1, the incident channel for that account, because Hollis isn't a member.
